resources.string: This code is not a valid Velo invite. Ask whoever runs your group for a new one.

Velo will connect to this group's private server, through Tor.

Check with whoever gave you the code that their phone shows the same verification code:

%s

If it is different, do not continue.
Velo already knows this server, but this invite points to a different address or different security keys. It could lead to a fake server, so it was not used. Ask whoever runs the group to check.
Show this code in person to the new member: they tap I have an invite and scan it. Then give them their user name and temporary password, by voice. The password is never in the code.
Choose a photo of the QR code
